newsitem.title: USA: Aseco Corp reaffirms cautious outlook.
newsitem.headline: Aseco Corp reaffirms cautious outlook.

text.p: Aseco Corp said Monday that its near-term outlook remains cautious after reporting second quarter earnings of $0.15 per share, down from year-ago per share earnings of $0.28.
The company said recent signs indicate demand in certain chip market niches are strengthening and said it is continuing strict cost controls.
"Our outlook for the near-term remains cautious," the company stated, adding that its market- and technology-driven product investments will continue to guide its long-term growth."
The company makes and sells equipment used by semiconductor manufacturers to test integrated circuits.
